question: (a) What is meant by secondary wavelets? (b) How is the new wavefront obtained from them?

options.A:
(a) Secondary wavelets are waves emitted only by the original source.
(b) The new wavefront is the backward envelope of the wavelets.
options.B:
(a) Secondary wavelets are waves emitted by the screen.
(b) The new wavefront is found by adding their amplitudes at one point.
options.C:
(a) Secondary wavelets are rays emitted normal to the original wavefront.
(b) The new wavefront is the locus of the centres of wavelets.
options.D:
(a) Secondary wavelets are small waves emitted by every point of a given wavefront according to Huygens principle.
(b) After time $t$, each has advanced a distance $vt$; the common forward envelope of all these wavelets gives the new wavefront.
